column1: # breeding-1.18.2.tsv — generated by tools/extract-breeding.mjs from the 1.18.2 jar.
# ⚠ NOTHING HERE IS TYPED IN. `AgeableMob` is the one class carrying the `ForcedAge` NBT
#   key and `Animal` the one carrying `InLove`; every constant is read from the method
#   that owns it and every food list from that species' own `isFood` override.
# kind: items = an explicit list · tag = an item tag · mixed = both · none = isFood is a
#   constant false and the animal CANNOT be bred (parrot, polar bear) · predicate = a rule
#   over the item itself (wolf: any edible item whose FoodProperties say meat), which is
#   NOT expanded into a list here because in vanilla it is not one.
# source: own = this class overrides isFood · inherit:<class> = it uses that one's rule.
